persona: Organised and talkative; puts everything in the first message. Has two photos, the locksmith note, the Police confirmation and the builder's quote on his laptop. Has not noticed that the quote has no date.
initial_message: Hi, I need to lodge a claim. Someone broke into my house at 1 Totara Test Rise in Chartwell, Hamilton on Friday 4 September while I was at work - they kicked in the back door, the jamb is split and the deadbolt is bent. I got home about 4:30pm and found it. I reported it to Police online that evening and have the event number, a locksmith came out that night and secured the door, nothing seems to be missing, and I've got photos and a builder's quote. My policy number is NW-SYN-HOM-200001.

design.notes: Missing field: the quote date on the repair quote (and with it the validity end date).

triage.rationale: The builder's quote prints no quote date and therefore no firm validity; a date is a required field of a repair quote, so someone must obtain a dated copy (evidence_outstanding). Everything else is in: two photos, the Police record with its event reference, the locksmith's attendance note and a quote total of NZD 3,174.00 including GST, under the threshold. The door is secured and the home habitable, nobody is hurt and no other party is involved, so nothing is complex. Main's theft branch also lists proof of ownership; nothing was taken and the claim is for the building, so the pack treats the photo, the repair quote and the Police record as the required materials. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt, proof of purchase or proof of ownership in the pack; nothing was taken

quote_before_loss.basis: The builder's quote prints no quote date (the field is blank), so the system cannot compare it with the incident; a missing date is not checked (rules, section 3).

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 February 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2017-02-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
